create_meeting.description: Schedule a Webex meeting and optionally invite people.
create_meeting.name: create_meeting

parameters.description: The name of the meeting, shown on the invite.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: When the meeting starts, as an ISO 8601 timestamp such as 2026-08-03T15:00:00Z.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: When the meeting ends, as an ISO 8601 timestamp such as 2026-08-03T15:30:00Z.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Optional. Timezone for the start and end times, for example 'America/New_York'.
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.description: Optional. An agenda or description for the meeting.
parameters.name: agenda

parameters.description: Optional. Email addresses to invite, as a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: invitees

meeting_id.description: Webex meeting ID. Use with Cancel a meeting.

meeting_number.description: The numeric meeting number people dial in with

password.description: Meeting password, when the site requires one

sip_address.description: SIP address for joining from a video system

timezone.description: Timezone the start and end times are expressed in

web_link.description: Link attendees use to join the meeting

parameters.description: The Webex meeting ID to cancel, as returned by Schedule a meeting or List meetings.
parameters.name: meeting_id

parameters.name: meeting_id

list_rooms.description: List the Webex spaces you belong to.
list_rooms.name: list_rooms

parameters.description: How many spaces to return (1-100).

last_activity.description: When the space was last active

room_id.description: Webex space ID. Use with Send a message.

type.description: Whether the space is a 'group' or a 'direct' one-to-one conversation

send_message.description: Post a message to a Webex space, or send it directly to one person by email.
send_message.name: send_message

parameters.description: The message to send.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: The Webex space to post in, as returned by List spaces. Provide this or a person's email, not both.
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.description: Send a direct message to this email address instead of posting in a space.
parameters.name: to_person_email

message_id.description: ID of the message that was sent

room_id.description: The space the message landed in

text.description: The message text as Webex stored it

update_meeting.description: Change a scheduled Webex meeting's title, time or agenda. Only the fields you fill in change. Changing a recurring meeting changes every occurrence.
update_meeting.name: update_meeting

parameters.description: The Webex meeting ID to change, as returned by Schedule a meeting or List meetings.
parameters.name: meeting_id

parameters.description: Optional. A new name for the meeting.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Optional. A new start time, such as 2026-08-03T15:00:00Z. Give the end time too.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Optional. A new end time, such as 2026-08-03T15:30:00Z. Give the start time too.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Optional. Timezone for the start and end times, for example 'America/New_York'.
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.description: Optional. A new agenda for the meeting.
parameters.name: agenda

parameters.description: Whether Webex emails the host and invitees about the change. On unless you turn it off.
parameters.name: send_email

description: Schedule Webex meetings and send messages to Webex spaces from your workflows.

cisco_webex_meeting_ended_trigger.description: Runs about 15 minutes after one of your Webex meetings ends, with its title, times and host, ready for a follow-up. Meetings that ended before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agenda: The meeting's agenda, if it has one.
output.meeting_id: The meeting's ID, for 'Get a meeting' and the other Webex steps.
output.meeting_number: The number people dial in with.
output.meeting_series_id: The scheduled meeting or series this one belongs to.
output.meeting_type: meetingSeries for a scheduled meeting or series, meeting for one that was held.
output.sip_address: The address for joining from a video system.
output.state: Where the meeting is, such as active, scheduled or ended.
output.timezone: The time zone of the start and end times.
output.title: The meeting's title.
output.web_link: The link to join the meeting.

cisco_webex_new_meeting_trigger.description: Runs when a Webex meeting you host or are invited to is scheduled, with its title, time and join link. Meetings already scheduled when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It watches the next year. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agenda: The meeting's agenda, if it has one.
output.meeting_id: The meeting's ID, for 'Get a meeting' and the other Webex steps.
output.meeting_number: The number people dial in with.
output.meeting_series_id: The scheduled meeting or series this one belongs to.
output.meeting_type: meetingSeries for a scheduled meeting or series, meeting for one that was held.
output.sip_address: The address for joining from a video system.
output.state: Where the meeting is, such as active, scheduled or ended.
output.timezone: The time zone of the start and end times.
output.title: The meeting's title.
output.web_link: The link to join the meeting.
